response.text: {"verdict": "covered", "clause_ids": ["A4.1"], "rationale": "The claim involves medication (nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs) prescribed as part of treatment for an acute injury (ankle sprain) that occurred during the trip. Clause A4.1 covers the cost of medication prescribed by a doctor for an acute illness or injury during the trip. There is no indication that the injury or medication relates to a pre-existing condition (A5.1) or that the treatment was planned in advance (A5.2)."}
